{{Top|leg}}
'''Atunda''' was the first [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Standard week/Legends|week]] in the [[Tapani calendar]]. It was followed by [[Katunda]], and preceded by [[Natunda]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
